structured.answer: I didn't decide anything. I'll ask my son or the bank. What I saw was Harel's provident fund for investment (קופת גמל להשקעה): 16 tracks, all with fees of about 0.54%–0.61% a year on the savings, below the legal limit of 1.05%. The returns were mostly 'less than 3 years', and there was nothing like a safe deposit.

stuck.why: Most rows say 'פחות מ־3 שנים' instead of a number, and I couldn't tell whether that means no data or a return below something
Only 'קופת גמל להשקעה' was shown. I didn't realise I had to press the other buttons to see pension, השתלמות and חיסכון לכל ילד, so I didn't see 'everything Harel offers'
It says direct expenses are taken in addition to the fee and 'לא מופיעות כאן', so I don't know the real cost
